lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple parallel horizontal tracks of high-intensity circular clusters, distributed with relatively uniform vertical and horizontal pitch across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid, most visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges extending across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light dorsal edges to shadowed ventral troughs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four parallel, dark, vertical linear features resembling deep lacerations or propeller scars are located posterior to the gill region. The apex of the first dorsal fin appears irregularly notched or truncated.
